Compare all shortlisted candidates on primary operation, physical object, and scope/detail, favoring a specific operation-object match over generic lexical overlap; fused rank is only a tie-breaker. For each reviewed item select exactly three distinct supplied artifact-local candidate_index values in final rank order.

Before durable persistence, confirm internally that the authoritative partition is disjoint and covers all assigned IDs, every review ID has exactly one successful evidence result and a concrete three-distinct-index decision, and every fallback ID has concrete valid ranked predictions from the server-side fused top-three fallback. You are working on your own; no one is available to answer questions or supply information you request. Complete the role assigned by your instruction and produce its requested deliverable. When the deliverable is for downstream agents, include the findings, evidence, assumptions, and uncertainty they need to continue. Do not take over sibling or downstream responsibilities unless your instruction explicitly requires it.
Do not ask the user for input or wait for a reply. If something is unclear, make a reasonable interpretation and name it in your deliverable. If evidence is unavailable, say what is missing and what that limits. Do not quote or discuss this notice.

You are the sole specialist for one assigned bounded construction-label batch. Use only sampo-benchmark and strictly execute the requested workflow. First inspect tool documentation as needed only to use advertised concrete parameters. For the supplied run_id and exact assigned IDs, prepare the candidate batch with exactly char_tfidf, construction_token_tfidf, word_tfidf, bm25_token, and char_word_fusion, each k=5, using fusion exactly rrf. Do not use exact-title, margin, staging, alternate retrievers, or altered settings. Immediately after prepare_candidate_batch, call partition_candidate_batch exactly once with the unmodified artifact_id and the complete assigned-ID list. Treat its disjoint review_ids and fallback_ids as authoritative; never reconstruct, modify, or repartition them.

Process only these assigned IDs. For every review ID, request get_candidate_evidence exactly once, selection='fused', candidate_limit=10, in requests containing no more than two review IDs. If any evidence request fails, stop this assigned unit and return a compact failure report; do not repeat that evidence request or make durable writes for an incomplete intended review. Review every disagreement ID semantically before persistence. Compare all shortlisted candidates on primary operation, physical object, and scope/detail, favoring a specific operation-object match over generic lexical overlap; fused rank is only a tie-breaker. For each reviewed item select exactly three distinct supplied artifact-local candidate_index values in final rank order.

Before durable persistence, confirm internally that the authoritative partition is disjoint and covers all assigned IDs, every review ID has exactly one successful evidence result and a concrete three-distinct-index decision, and every fallback ID has concrete valid ranked predictions from the server-side fused top-three fallback. Then use exactly one durable path per ID: save_review_decisions only for all review_ids with their exact artifact-local indices, and save_candidate_predictions only for all fallback_ids. Never include a reviewed ID in fallback saving, never overlap IDs across durable calls, never retry a rejected or completed durable write, and never write an ID twice. Complete all intended review before either durable write. Do not call stage_candidate_predictions, do not save fallback predictions for the full batch, and do not process any other IDs or finalize the run.

After both durable write paths succeed, make absolutely no further MCP calls: no status verification, retrieval, preparation, or finalization. Return immediately with a compact completion report containing the artifact_id, counts/IDs of reviewed and fallback items, and confirmation that both complementary durable paths succeeded. If there are no IDs in one partition, use only the required durable path for the nonempty partition, provided the tool contract permits it, and state that compactly. Never expose bulky full evidence in your response.

Before you finish: do not close by asking the user for anything -- not a decision, not a document, not a reply. Whatever you would have offered to prepare next, either do it now or leave it out.
